integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action, cinematic, with a single 2D-animated element composited into the live-action frame, a medium shot frames a narrow 1910s boarding-house bedroom at rainy dawn, photoreal and desaturated in cold grey-green, lit only by one tall rain-streaked window, with peeling wallpaper, a heavy dark wooden bed, a small table stacked with folded cloth samples, a framed magazine cut-out on the wall and three closed doors, carrying visible 35mm grain. Lying on the bed on his armoured back is Gregor, rendered as a flat 2D hand-drawn cel-animated beetle with bold black ink outlines, simple cel shading, a domed brown shell, a segmented belly divided by stiff arched ridges, and many thin jointed legs, laid over the photoreal set like an animation cel with no blending between the two. The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed toward the shell, which rises and falls faintly. A calm, low, measured middle-aged male voice (S1) says in an off-screen voiceover: <d>[Chinese] 一天早晨，格里高尔从不安的梦中醒来，发现自己变成了一只巨大的甲虫。他仰面躺着，背壳坚硬如铁。稍一抬头，就看见隆起的褐色肚皮，被一道道弓形硬痕分成数块。</d> while the beetle's mandibles remain completely closed and no character on screen moves their mouth. The beetle lifts its head a little and the ridged brown belly comes into view.

overall_soundscape: Steady rain taps a tin window ledge and runs down the glass throughout. A slow clock ticks in the room, and dry chitin scrapes and clicks against bed linen and floorboards. The room tone stays quiet with a boxy indoor reverb.

non_diegetic_music: A single sustained low cello note at a very slow tempo, joined by a faint high metallic shimmer that holds at a constant low volume and does not swell.
